explanation: I searched Mathlib for lemmas about Γ of a restricted SheafedSpace or PresheafedSpace, and for global sections of restrictions in general. I found only `SheafedSpace.Γ_obj_op`, which says Γ(op X) = X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤), and `Opens.isOpenEmbedding_obj_top`. Neither gives the statement alone. Combining them also needs a defeq `change` step, so the derivation is not a one- or two-line application of a single declaration. Nothing in Mathlib states Γ.obj (op (X.restrict _)) = X.presheaf.obj (op U) directly.
